statement: Every variable a MindAnchor research export can contain. Frozen: a change to this document requires a new version, and the old version stays readable forever.
missingDataStatement: Nothing is imputed, interpolated, carried forward, or filled in. Every absence in the reported window is listed with a reason. The window is stated in this file: it ends on the export date — never after it, because a day that has not happened cannot be missing — and reaches back about ten years. When no record falls inside it the window is absent and no absence is reported, which is not the same as having missed nothing. Records dated outside the window are excluded from it and from the reasons given inside it, and still appear in the data.

variables.name: id
variables.description: Stable identifier for this entry.

variables.name: createdAt
variables.description: When the entry was first saved.

variables.name: updatedAt
variables.description: When the entry was last written.

variables.name: localDate
variables.description: The local calendar date the entry belongs to. The join key for daily analysis.

variables.name: title
variables.description: The title the person typed. Empty if they typed none.

variables.name: body
variables.description: The entry in the person's own words, stored exactly as written. Nothing reads meaning from it.

variables.name: kind
variables.description: Which writing surface produced the entry.

variables.name: sourceDeviceId
variables.description: The phone that recorded the entry.

variables.name: deletedAt
variables.description: When the person removed the entry, or null. The row is kept; content is never destroyed.

variables.name: id
variables.description: Stable identifier for this context row.

variables.name: entryId
variables.description: The Journal entry this was derived from.

variables.name: recordType
variables.description: FACT for a structural observation. INFERENCE exists in the schema but this build derives none.

variables.name: key
variables.description: Which structural fact this row holds.

variables.name: value
variables.description: The fact's value, as text.

variables.name: sourceStart
variables.description: Start offset in the entry body, or null.

variables.name: sourceEnd
variables.description: End offset in the entry body, or null.

variables.name: confidence
variables.description: Always 1.0 in this build: a structural count is not a guess.

variables.name: extractorVersion
variables.description: The transformation version that produced the row.

variables.name: createdAt
variables.description: When the row was derived.

variables.name: id
variables.description: Stable identifier for this measure.

variables.name: localDate
variables.description: The local calendar date the measure covers. One measure per date.

variables.name: createdAt
variables.description: When the measure was first saved.

variables.name: updatedAt
variables.description: When the measure was last edited.

variables.name: mood
variables.description: Self-rated 1 to 5, where 1 is "Low" and 5 is "High". A personal research measure. No total, threshold, or cut-off is computed from it anywhere.

variables.name: anxiety
variables.description: Self-rated 1 to 5, where 1 is "Calm" and 5 is "Tense". A personal research measure. No total, threshold, or cut-off is computed from it anywhere.

variables.name: angerUrge
variables.description: Self-rated 1 to 5, where 1 is "Steady" and 5 is "Reactive". A personal research measure. No total, threshold, or cut-off is computed from it anywhere.

variables.name: energyFunction
variables.description: Self-rated 1 to 5, where 1 is "Depleted" and 5 is "Energized". A personal research measure. No total, threshold, or cut-off is computed from it anywhere.

variables.name: sleepQuality
variables.description: Self-rated 1 to 5, where 1 is "Poor" and 5 is "Great". A personal research measure. No total, threshold, or cut-off is computed from it anywhere.

variables.name: instrumentVersion
variables.description: The version of the five-item measure that was answered.

variables.name: sourceDeviceId
variables.description: The phone that recorded the measure.

variables.name: id
variables.description: The event's own hash. The row is content-addressed.

variables.name: sequence
variables.description: Position in the chain, 1-based and contiguous.

variables.name: kind
variables.description: What the event records.

variables.name: occurredAt
variables.description: When the recorded thing happened.

variables.name: recordedAt
variables.description: When the row was written. Never rewritten.

variables.name: localDate
variables.description: The local calendar date of occurredAt. The join key for daily analysis.

variables.name: studyPhaseId
variables.description: The study phase in effect when the row was written.

variables.name: sourceDeviceId
variables.description: The phone that wrote the row.

variables.name: note
variables.description: The person's own words about the event, stored exactly as written and never interpreted. Empty for events MindAnchor wrote about itself.

variables.name: payloadJson
variables.description: Structured detail for an event MindAnchor wrote about itself. "{}" for a self-reported one.

variables.name: previousEventHash
variables.description: The preceding event's hash. Empty at sequence 1.

variables.name: eventHash
variables.description: This event's hash, over its own contents plus the previous hash.

variables.name: id
variables.description: The phase's own hash over its ordinal, start and version vector.

variables.name: ordinal
variables.description: Position in the sequence of phases, 0-based.

variables.name: startedAt
variables.description: When the phase opened. A phase has no end: it runs until the next one starts.

variables.name: reason
variables.description: Which part of the version vector changed to open this phase.

variables.name: appVersionCode
variables.description: The app build in effect during the phase.

variables.name: appVersionName
variables.description: The app version name in effect during the phase.

variables.name: protocolCatalogSha256
variables.description: Content hash of the evidence protocol catalogue in effect.

variables.name: ruleSetVersion
variables.description: The decision-rule set in effect. This build ships none.

variables.name: modelSetVersion
variables.description: The model set in effect. This build ships none.

variables.name: transformationSetVersion
variables.description: Content hash of the transformation registry in effect.

variables.name: missingDataPolicyVersion
variables.description: The missing-data policy in effect.

variables.name: instrumentVersion
variables.description: The morning-measure instrument in effect.

variables.name: dictionaryVersion
variables.description: The data dictionary in effect.

variables.name: sourceDeviceId
variables.description: The phone the phase opened on.

variables.name: localDate
variables.description: The local calendar date the value is absent for.

variables.name: variable
variables.description: Which variable is absent.

variables.name: reason
variables.description: Why it is absent. Nothing is filled in to replace it.
